pretreatment: boiling in trichloroethylene for 5 min, then in acetone for 5 min, immersed in methanol, washed with neutral soap and rubbed with cotton, rinsed in running water over night, rinsed in deionized water and quickly blown dry with N2
evidence: The soda-lime-glass substrates were cleaned by first boiling them in trichloroethylene for 5 min, then in acetone for 5 min, immersed in methanol, washed with neutral soap and rubbed with cotton. Thereafter, they were rinsed in running water over night, then rinsed in deionized water and quickly blown dry with N2.
